summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 23, 2026. The meeting agenda includes reappointment of directors and external directors, approval of RSU grants to officers and directors, and a vote on a Securities Exchange Agreement with VisionWave Holdings, Inc. No forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board departure is described; the filing is a routine proxy solicitation. No deal terms such as price, premium, or consideration are stated. The event is an ordinary corporate governance matter.
